segments.text: Morning everyone. Quick weekly sync. How was the long weekend, did anyone get out of the city?
Went hiking, it was great. Also the coffee machine on the third floor is finally fixed, by the way.
Nice. Okay, let's get into it. Main thing today: we need to decide whether to cut the CSV export from the v0 release.
I think we should cut CSV export from v0. It's not core and it's eating time we need for stability. We can add it in v0.1.
Agreed. Decision: CSV export is out of v0 and moves to v0.1. Everyone okay with that? Okay, decided.
On stability — I'll take the crash on the settings screen. I'll have a fix up by Thursday. That's my action item.
And I'll write the migration guide for the new config format. I can get a draft to the team by next Monday.
Good. One thing I'm not sure about: do we need a feature flag for the new onboarding, or do we just ship it to everyone? Let's leave that open for now and revisit.
A risk I want to flag: if the migration isn't done before we cut the release branch, existing users could hit a broken config on upgrade. We should watch that closely.
Yeah. Also unrelated, lunch order form is due at noon if anyone wants in. That's it from me.
Great, thanks all. Let's sync again next week.
